passages.title: The Missed Bus
passages.text: Yesterday, I missed the bus, so I walked to the station. I bought a ticket and called my friend.
passages.levelRationale: A short sequence uses frequent past-tense verbs and a familiar travel situation.

chunks.text: Yesterday, I missed the bus, so I walked to the station.
I bought a ticket and called my friend.

passages.title: At the Grocery Store
passages.text: I need rice, tomatoes, and fresh bread. After work, I will stop at the store and carry everything home.
passages.levelRationale: A concrete shopping task combines a simple list with a future plan.

chunks.text: I need rice, tomatoes, and fresh bread.
After work, I will stop at the store and carry everything home.

passages.title: An Evening Call
passages.text: My sister called me after dinner. We talked about her new job, and we planned to meet on Saturday.
passages.levelRationale: Familiar family and work vocabulary appears in two linked past events.

chunks.text: My sister called me after dinner.
We talked about her new job, and we planned to meet on Saturday.

passages.title: A Healthy Break
passages.text: I sit at a computer all morning. Every hour, I stand up, drink some water, and stretch my legs.
passages.levelRationale: A familiar routine uses present-tense actions and a simple time expression.

chunks.text: I sit at a computer all morning.
Every hour, I stand up, drink some water, and stretch my legs.

passages.title: A Weekend Picnic
passages.text: We packed fruit and sandwiches for the picnic. The sun was warm, and the children played beside the lake.
passages.levelRationale: A familiar outing is described with frequent past-tense verbs and concrete details.

chunks.text: We packed fruit and sandwiches for the picnic.
The sun was warm, and the children played beside the lake.

passages.title: A Rainy Commute
passages.text: It started raining before I left home. I wore my blue coat and carried an umbrella to the office.
passages.levelRationale: A simple past event combines familiar weather, clothing, and travel vocabulary.

chunks.text: It started raining before I left home.
I wore my blue coat and carried an umbrella to the office.
